comparison: A single registered R4 query and its predicted word condition one generated JPEG per arm, with matched per-photo noise. These cases use the same photos in both participants. Endpoint pairs hold true class and fold fixed and require both predictions to name the correct class. The reciprocal subset also requires the wrong arm to exchange exactly those two EEG residuals.
units: Credit counts split ties; cosine margin is per pair. Paired percentile 95% intervals resample represented true object classes within each panel and participant. Intra10 follows the prior separately centered panel gallery; pair decisions use raw unit CLIP vectors. The recipient's row seed is held fixed across arms, so a uniform condition can distinguish pairs by chance.
